'''Hammel''' is a male Security NPC found at [[Startorch Academy (Region)|Startorch Academy - Square]], regaling the tale of [[Zahira]] misdemeanors to deliver lunch to her sister, [[Aluna]]. 

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
:'''Hammel:''' ...Last time, she crossed the back gate on a reindeer, charging toward the cafeteria like a bat out of hell.
:'''Sarafina:''' W-what on earth was she doing?!
:'''Hammel:''' Just dropping off lunch for her sister, Aluna. Then  she left like it was the most normal thing in the world.
:'''Sarafina:''' That's... one way to make a delivery.
{{Dialogue End}}
